title: Open Subsurface Data record, version 2
description: One dataset as published by its owner. Facts about the dataset, never facts produced by our tools: verification levels, checksums and outlines live in build output, not here. Version 2 adds `inputs` and the optional `period` (E04, additive); every version-1 record is a valid version-2 record.

id.description: publisher-slug/dataset-slug; stable forever, also the file path records/<id>.yaml

summary.description: Two or three sentences in the publisher's own terms.

url.description: The page a person opens to get the data. Never a deep link that expires.

access.description: anonymous: a download needs no account; registration: a free account; api: a documented service; request: a human approves

manifest_url.description: Optional machine-readable listing of files (index, API, bucket listing) the verifier can checksum against.

name.description: The licence as the publisher names it.

spdx.description: SPDX identifier when one exists (CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-SA-4.0, OGL-UK-3.0, NLOD-2.0); null for bespoke licences.

redistribution.description: May a third party host a copy? Decides whether the mirror store may hold this dataset.

share_alike.description: Derived products must carry the same licence (CC BY-SA and kin).

statement.description: The attribution line a derived product must carry, verbatim when the publisher prescribes one.

kinds.description: What the dataset holds, in the vocabulary of the Ophiolite kind registry (E55) where it overlaps; source-list marks a page that lists other datasets.

bbox.description: [west, south, east, north] in WGS84 decimal degrees, approximate, for the map's first zoom only.

crs.description: The dataset's own CRS as the publisher states it, e.g. EPSG:23031.

stated.description: As the publisher states it, e.g. '~5 TB including seismic'.

listed_by.description: Where we found it; seg-wiki means https://wiki.seg.org/wiki/Open_data

osdu.description: Identifiers in the OSDU reference data where the same dataset is carried.

inputs.description: The publisher's own addresses for the geometry of this dataset (register services, files, stores), each with the CRS and units as the publisher states them. Extraction rules are tool configuration (src/osd/outlines/rules.yaml, OSD-D11), never fields here.

name.description: Unique within the record; the key of its rule in rules.yaml.

url.description: As the publisher serves it, e.g. a WFS GetFeature request for one layer, a file, or a store prefix.

format.description: html-geojson: a page that carries a GeoJSON geometry the publisher labels as the extent.

crs.description: The CRS the publisher declares for the coordinates. Absent means not declared: the input is refused, never guessed.

units.description: Coordinate units when the publisher states them outside the data.

stated.description: Where and how the publisher states the CRS and units, verbatim where short.

period.description: The acquisition or release interval the publisher states for the dataset, inclusive (OSD-D14: STAC Items exist only for records with a period). Quote the dates in YAML ('1993', not 1993).

start.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD; the interval starts at the beginning of it (UTC).

end.description: YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD; the interval ends at the end of it (UTC).

stated.description: Where and how the publisher states it, verbatim where short.
